name: LibreTexts Chemistry
description: Open-access chemistry textbooks from the LibreTexts project — every result is free to read online and download as PDF. Scoped to the Chemistry collection; Math, Physics and Biology sit on separate hosts that require an API token.
readableNote: Verified anonymously 2026-10-01. /@api/deki/site/search returns JSON with no token, and every result id maps to a real PDF at /@api/deki/pages/{id}/pdf/ (id 31334 -> 200, 45 KB, %PDF-; id 1919 -> 200, 81 KB).
